HomePage.title: AI-Powered Nutrition Tracking
HomePage.description: Track your meals with natural language, let AI estimate your nutrition, and monitor your daily and weekly progress effortlessly.
HomePage.feature1Text: Describe your meal in plain English and let AI break it down into calories and macros.
HomePage.feature2Text: Automatically calculated calorie and macro goals based on your profile and fitness objective.
HomePage.feature3Text: Monitor your daily and weekly nutrition with clear insights and structured data.
